description: This file defines a sealed class ReferenceEqualsComparer that implements IEqualityComparer<object> and IEqualityComparer, providing reference-based equality comparison and hash code generation.

classes.name: ReferenceEqualsComparer
classes.description: A sealed class implementing reference equality comparison for objects, used for identity-based hashing and equality checks.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Determines if two objects are the same instance using reference equality.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Returns a hash code based on the object's identity, using RuntimeHelpers.GetHashCode.
